messages.content: Portland answers finally came in. Lab access Friday is 4 to 6, Sunday teardown should be done by 5:30, and they sent a rideshare drop-off near the therapy building. Can we book the safer Friday flight and the suite hotel if the fare still holds? I do not want the cheap late routing unless there is a huge reason.

Yes. This is bookable now. The practical lead is still the Friday morning connection: Tampa 8:05 a.m., connect in Dallas, arrive Portland 1:42 p.m. The cheaper later routing is only about $68 less and would leave almost no cushion if the connection slipped, so I would drop it. For Monday, the afternoon return that still prices well leaves Portland at 2:15 p.m. and gets into Tampa at 11:56 p.m. Caveat before booking: that is a late home arrival. Hotel-wise, the suite property is the predictable choice; the campus guesthouse is closer but still will not verify the in-room fridge. Suite caveats: no hot tub, and you will need an 8-12 minute rideshare to campus.
The late Tampa arrival is okay. Tuesday is admin, not a teaching day. Please grab windows wherever the seat map lets you.

I am at checkout now. Fare is still holding at $546 round trip. Flight details: Friday TPA-DFW 8:05-9:58, DFW-PDX 11:15-1:42. Monday PDX-DFW 2:15-7:43, DFW-TPA 8:45-11:56. Seat map note: window seats are available on both outbound legs and the Dallas-to-Tampa return leg. The Portland-to-Dallas return leg is not allowing seat selection until check-in. Proceed with that?
Proceed. And for the hotel, it is the queen studio, not a two-double room, right?

Correct. The available room type is a queen studio with one queen bed. It lists an in-room coffee maker, mini-fridge, fitness room access, indoor pool, and free Wi-Fi. No hot tub. Cancellation is free until 6 p.m. three days before arrival; after that it is one night plus tax.
That works. Book both.

Flights are booked. Airline confirmation PR7K2M. Seats selected: 14A Tampa-Dallas, 18F Dallas-Portland, and 21A Dallas-Tampa. Portland-Dallas is marked for check-in seat selection, and I added a reminder to check in right when it opens so we can try for a window there.
Great. Hotel too?

Reserved. Hotel confirmation PSU-48216, Friday through Monday, queen studio at $189 per night before taxes and fees, pay at property. The reservation reconfirms coffee maker, mini-fridge, fitness room, and indoor pool. The missing recovery piece is still the hot tub.
Campus commute: anything annoying with the rideshare drop-off they sent?

Manageable. Use the therapy building north drop-off the host marked, not the main university entrance. Friday plan: land 1:42, rideshare by about 2:20, hotel bag drop around 2:50, leave by 3:20, arrive campus 3:35-3:45 for the 4:00 unlock. If checked bag pickup slips past 2:30, skip the hotel and go straight to campus.
Add the last open items so I don't forget what to ask the host.

Done. Open host items: name and phone of the Friday unlock contact, whether the marked rideshare drop-off is usable during summer access hours, exact room for secure overnight storage, Sunday teardown still targeting 5:30, and whether anyone needs to sign you out after teardown. Portland is now booked with the suite-hotel caveats noted: no hot tub, short campus rideshare, and one return-leg seat to select at check-in.

messages.content: Portland update: the airline moved my first Friday segment 25 minutes earlier. Annoying, but if it protects the connection maybe leave it. Can you sanity-check and slot the campus map into Friday?

Keep it. The Tampa departure is now 7:40 a.m., the Dallas layover is longer, and Portland arrival is still 1:42 p.m. Downside is the earlier start at TPA. Upside is less connection stress before the 4:00 lab access. I would not re-shop unless you want to accept a later-arrival risk.
Keep it then. What time should I be at TPA?
Aim to walk into TPA by 6:00 a.m. If you are checking the demo case, 6:10 is the latest I would be comfortable with. Boarding should be around 7:05.
Hotel reconfirmed the room basics, right?
Yes: queen studio, in-room coffee maker, mini-fridge, fitness room, and indoor pool. Still no hot tub. They can hold your bag if the room is not ready when you arrive.
The university map shows construction at the usual entrance. Which drop-off are we using?

Use the east-side rehab sciences drop-off on Campus Way, the one labeled temporary therapy access. Tell the rideshare driver not to follow signs to the main visitor circle. From that drop-off, it is a short walk through the covered walkway to the therapy building check-in.
And Monday? I don't want to drag bags around or cut the airport close.

Monday plan: pack after breakfast, check out by 11:15, ask the desk to hold bags only if you step out nearby, and be in the rideshare by 11:30. That should put you at PDX around 12:05 for the 2:15 p.m. return. Friday sequence is now: TPA by 6:00, land PDX 1:42, hotel bag drop if rideshare is moving by 2:25; if not, go straight to the temporary therapy drop-off and check in at the lab by 3:45.

messages.content: New Baltimore request. A children's hospital group wants me Thursday and Friday, August 15 and 16, for gait training. They want me on site by 7:30 Thursday, and Friday demos are supposed to end around 3:45. Can you compare flights and hotels by what is practical, not just cheapest?

Yes. I will treat Wednesday August 14 as the outbound, because a Thursday morning arrival would be too exposed for a 7:30 start. I am checking BWI first since it is the cleanest airport for the hospital area; DCA only becomes worth it if the fare difference is dramatic.
BWI first. I will probably have one checked equipment case, and I do not want a setup scramble.

Best flight shapes from Tampa to BWI: most practical is a Wednesday 10:35 a.m. nonstop arriving 12:45 p.m., about $238, with enough room for bags, hotel check-in, and possible afternoon setup. Still workable is a 1:55 p.m. nonstop arriving 4:05, about $221, but it only works if the host does not need much Wednesday setup. Cheapest is a 5:30 p.m. one-stop arriving after 10:00 p.m.; I would not use that before a 7:30 hospital start.
The 10:35 sounds easiest. Is the 1:55 actually risky or just less comfortable?

Less comfortable if everything runs on time, risky if the checked case is slow or the host expects you to inspect space Wednesday. With the 10:35, you could be at the hotel around 2:00 and at the hospital by 3:15 or 3:30 if they allow setup. With the 1:55, you are probably not walking into the hospital before 5:00.
Return is where I am torn. Can I realistically fly Friday night?

Maybe, but it is tight. If demos end at 3:45, assume 30-45 minutes for questions, packing, and getting the equipment case out. That puts you leaving the hospital around 4:45 or 5:00. A 7:25 p.m. nonstop from BWI is possible only if traffic behaves and pack-up does not stretch. The later Friday options get you home very late, closer to midnight or after.
So Saturday afternoon is less heroic.

Exactly. Saturday has a 1:35 p.m. nonstop arriving Tampa around 3:58 p.m., about $212. Saturday morning is also available around 9:55, but it means an early checkout after two heavy days and does not save enough money to be compelling. The afternoon return gives you a normal morning, easy bag handling, and a usable evening at home.
Okay, tentatively Saturday afternoon. Now hotels. The hospital rate is tempting, but uneven reviews before 7:30 starts make me nervous.

Two practical hotel choices. Closest is the hospital-rate hotel: about $159 per night, 4-6 minutes by rideshare or hospital shuttle, customer rating around 3.7, with recent complaints about room wear and slow elevators. In-room fridge is not confirmed; coffee appears to be lobby-level, not clearly in-room. The stronger stay is the suite property 15 minutes away: about $205 per night, rating around 4.4, queen studio, in-room coffee maker, mini-fridge, fitness room, and indoor pool. No hot tub, and parking is $18 per night.
Parking fee does not matter if I rideshare, right?

Correct. I do not see a reason to rent a car unless the host says the hospital entrance is hard to reach by rideshare. Rideshare should be cheaper than parking plus rental, and the suite commute is not silly: leave around 6:55 a.m. for a 7:30 hospital arrival, with a little buffer.
What if the host guarantees good storage and says Friday pack-up is done by 4:30? Would that change the return?

It would make the Friday 7:25 nonstop possible, but I still would not call it the best plan unless you really need to be home Friday night. You would be relying on no late questions, no elevator delay, no traffic snag, and no checked-case issue at BWI. Saturday afternoon removes that failure point.
Let's not book until they answer. What exactly should I ask them?

Ask the host: what time you can access the training space Wednesday afternoon, who can meet you, where to unload the equipment case, whether there is secure overnight storage Wednesday and Thursday nights, whether the same room is used both days, whether elevators or loading docks require badges, and whether Friday pack-up is expected to be complete by 4:30 or closer to 5:00.
Add entrance and morning badge details. Last hospital visit had me at the wrong door.

Add: exact rideshare drop-off address for the education or rehab entrance, whether construction affects that entrance, where visitor badges are issued before 7:30 a.m., whether the security desk opens by 7:15, and a direct cell number for the Thursday morning contact if the main entrance is not staffed yet.
Good. Give me the current hold plan in one screen.

Current Baltimore hold plan, not booked: Wednesday 10:35 a.m. TPA-BWI nonstop arriving 12:45 p.m. as the practical outbound; Saturday 1:35 p.m. BWI-TPA nonstop arriving about 3:58 p.m. as the cleaner return; suite hotel as the lead because it has the better rating, queen studio, in-room coffee maker, mini-fridge, fitness room, and indoor pool. Caveats: suite has no hot tub and is a 15-minute rideshare to the hospital; hospital-rate hotel stays as proximity backup but has uneven reviews and unclear fridge details. Waiting on host answers about Wednesday setup, secure storage, exact entrance, badge timing, and Friday pack-up before booking.
